probes.notes: DAG 9 nodes; run.mode deprecation warning spammed 13x; 3 playbooks fail to load

findings.title: run.mode deprecation warning printed once per task, drowning real warnings
findings.evidence: node packages/cli/dist/index.js run --playbook self-improvement-loop --dry emitted 'run.mode is deprecated and ignored' 13 times — once for each task in the 9-node DAG. Actual warnings (3 playbooks failing to load) are buried in the noise.
findings.suggested_fix: Deduplicate repeated deprecation warnings at the logger level, or emit once at config-load time rather than per-task.
findings.regression_check: Run --dry and assert deprecation warning count <= 1
